claim: PjBL benefits depend on implementation conditions, making scaffolding and orchestration central design concerns.
Carefully structured AI support can improve learning or tutoring quality, whereas unconstrained assistance can undermine durable learner agency.
Educational chatbot support often emphasizes strategy enactment more than the full SRL cycle.
Teacher-facing analytics should preserve educator control and connect signals to actionable classroom context.
OpenPBL implements evidence gating, role and stage boundaries, teacher authority, and interruption-aware companion policies.
OpenPBL improves student learning, agency, cognitive load, or teacher workload.
